title: Add an admin users endpoint and login redirect
description: Adds the route the admin console uses to list accounts and a helper that sends users back to where they were headed after login.

expected.note: The handler only checks that a session exists and then lists every account; it never verifies the caller is an admin, so any logged-in user can read the full user table. Add an authorization check (session.role === "admin") before the query and return 403 otherwise.

The `next` query parameter is passed straight into new URL() as the redirect target, so ?next=https://evil.example sends users to an attacker's site. Validate that the target is a same-origin relative path before redirecting.
